title: Rate of Change: Motion Problems
body:
A particle moves along a straight line according to $s(t) = t^3 - 6t^2 + 9t + 2$, where $s$ is in metres and $t$ is in seconds.

a) Find the velocity function and determine when the particle is at rest.
b) Find the acceleration when $t = 2$ seconds.
